sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, currently top of the table with 22 points from 10 games, host Alsager Town on Saturday 3 October at 15:00. The league leaders will be strong favourites against Alsager, who sit bottom with just 4 points and have won only once all season. Sandbach's most recent result was a loss, but they remain unbeaten in most of their recent campaign with seven wins in their last ten games.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town travel to Dawley Town on Saturday, looking to close the one-point gap at the top after their own recent loss. Third-ranked AFC Bridgnorth host Eccleshall in what shapes as a mid-table clash, with Eccleshall currently sixth and in decent form. Wolverhampton Casuals, fourth in the standings, welcome Wednesfield Community to what will be a competitive fixture before meeting Brereton Social in a midweek clash on Wednesday 7 October. Bilston Town (sixth, 17 points) travel to Foley Meir in a battle between mid-table sides, while Barnton host Shawbury United—a notable fixture given Shawbury's concerning run of six consecutive losses. Market Drayton Town face New Mills on Saturday, both seeking to climb away from the lower reaches. Cheadle Heath Nomads visit Telford Town in a clash between two struggling sides at the bottom end of the table, while Crewe play host to Allscott Heath and Brereton Social welcome Widnes Town (who have just 2 points from 7 games) on the opening Saturday.
